summary: Master property technology and smart building management with practical tools for maintenance, energy, tenant service, and reporting.
lede: Smart building management training helps property and facilities professionals connect building systems, maintenance, energy use and tenant feedback to operational decisions. It covers assessing portfolio readiness, interpreting performance dashboards, planning predictive maintenance and energy improvements, and mapping technology risks. Participants practice using sensor, automation, work-order and energy data to develop maintenance plans, improvement roadmaps and performance reports.
audienceIntro: This course is for you if you manage, support, or influence connected buildings and need clearer control over maintenance, energy, tenant experience, and technology decisions.
prerequisites: Bring an understanding of property or facilities operations, a laptop for workshop exercises, and any sample work order, energy, or dashboard data you are allowed to use internally. If your organization uses CAFM, CMMS, BMS, or smart building dashboards, those references will make the exercises more relevant, but the course also works with generic operational examples provided during training.
